description:
Assess schedule risk for an estimate using historical accuracy data.

Computes confidence intervals (p50/p80/p95) based on your team's MAPE.
Returns risk level and actionable recommendations.
Uses industry baseline (25% MAPE) when no historical data is available.

ai_native.description: Degree of AI assistance: 0.0 = fully human, 1.0 = fully AI-native, 0.5 = hybrid. Accepts boolean for backward compatibility (true=1.0, false=0.0).

complexity.description: Task complexity from 1 (trivial) to 5 (extreme). Higher complexity widens confidence intervals.

estimated_hours.description: The estimated effort in hours to assess risk for.

project.description: Optional project/repo identifier this estimate belongs to, for cross-project analytics.

session_id.description: Optional session identifier (minted by a calling agent/hook) used to deduplicate repeated estimate calls for the same task within a session.

task_label.description: Optional free-text label identifying the task this estimate is for (e.g. an issue key or short title). Surfaced on get_pending_estimates output for triage.

task_type.description: Optional task type to refine historical accuracy lookup.

team_id.description: Optional team identifier to scope historical data.

name: schedule_risk
